Lemma
[Extension of boundary data] 1. ch6:6.38\group gt-ch06 Let $\Omega $ be $C^{k,\alpha }$, $k\ge 1$, and $\Omega '$ contain $\bar\Omega $. Every $\varphi \in C^{k,\alpha }(\partial \Omega )$ has an extension $\Phi \in C_0^{k,\alpha }(\Omega ')$ satisfying $\Phi =\varphi $ on $\partial \Omega $. The same holds locally for a $C^{k,\alpha }$ boundary portion and for $\varphi \in C^0(\partial \Omega )\cap C^{k,\alpha }(T)$, with a $C^0$ extension globally and $C^{k,\alpha }$ regularity near $T$.
Proof

\sketch In flattened coordinates set $\widetilde\Phi (y',y_n)=\widetilde\varphi (y')$, then patch the local constructions by a partition of unity as in Lemma 6.37.

□
